question: Who among the following musicians plays Carnatic music and also known as ‘God of Ghatam’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__TH Vinayakram.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **T H Vinayakram (also known as Vikku Vinayakram) **is a legendary **ghatam player **who use **clay pot percussion instrument **in the Indian classical music.
 
• He is known as the** "God of Ghatam". **
 
• His was honoured with prestigious awards like the **Padma Shri and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**
 
• Carnatic music originates in south India back over 2000 years.
 
• Some of the most revered composers in Carnatic music include: **Tyagaraja (1767–1847),** **Muthuswami Dikshitar (1775–**1835), Syama Sastri (1762–1827), Papanasam Sivan (1890–1973), Swathi Thirunal (1813-1846).<
